Interpret each interaction in the context of the complete email. Do not infer that a request has been followed or that an action has succeeded.

Do not create industry-specific or provider-specific versions of an interaction. Evaluate the named categories below; do not invent narrower categories or fill a label quota. If no category is supported, the email can be labelled Undetermined.

Does the complete email express the following interaction: establishing contact or continuing a conversation, such as arranging a callback or moving to another communication channel? Contact or continued dialogue must itself be substantive. Do not add this label merely because the email asks for a reply containing factual information, or includes routine contact details or a support invitation.
